loop: First mate coordination of intercept tuning and production flash lighting
worked: Comparing deterministic rear and crossing intercepts helped me distinguish where turn authority and braking each changed the flight path.
Comparing production frames across three consecutive ticks exposed the broad flash and let me verify its timing after correction.

issues.observation: I initially reported the 14u central flash and omitted the study’s immediate 180u illumination.
issues.effect: The user had to ask about the illumination again, and production lighting required correction.

issues.observation: Earlier specs repeated the same rules in the Blueprint, checklists and scenarios.
issues.effect: I had to edit those rules in multiple places before verification.
